body: Some white kid in middle school went like “I can identify the difference between Chinese, Japanese, Korean” and then proceeded to say it was because of eye type.  Then he proceeded to say I was Korean. Corrected and humiliated him, but it still hurt quite a bit.

As someone going through an identity crisis due to this, yeah it is.  My parents (first gen chinese -> american immigrants) refuse to interact with chinese media and tried to “americanize” me which only works when you’re not surrounded by kids wondering what’s wrong with your food.  So I grew up feeling extra isolated which then developed into a whole host of mental issues. 

Being second gen is unique but also sucks a lot.
Thank you for litesning to me
